label: def:q-local-system
title: $q$-Local system
html:
Definition. q-Local system

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q \in \mathbb{G}_m^{\mathrm{nt}}(k) (substrate parameter), and let X be a brane curve. A q-local system on X with structure group G_q is a functor

  \mathcal{L}_q \colon \Pi_1(X) \longrightarrow \mathbf{Rep}(G_q)

from the fundamental groupoid \Pi_1(X) to the category of finite-dimensional representations of G_q. This functor must satisfy the q-monodromy condition: for every contractible loop \varrho \colon \mathbf{1} \to \mathbf{1} in \Pi_1(X), the monodromy obeys

  \mathcal{L}_q(\varrho) = \mathrm{id} + (q - 1)\Omega_q(\varrho),

where \Omega_q(\varrho) \in \mathrm{End}(\tau(\mathcal{L}_q)) is the q-holonomy residue determined by the underlying q-connection (q-flat connection).

The q-monodromy condition reflects the local geometry of the \mathbb{G}_m-family. At q = 1, the residue vanishes and \mathcal{L}_1 reduces to a classical flat bundle. For q \neq 1, the non-vanishing curvature d_q^2 \neq 0 (non-vanishing of d_q^2) obstructs trivial monodromy. The Kummer reduction of the obstruction class \kappa_0 at level n (Kummer filtration) controls lifting through the brane tower. A q-local system \mathcal{L}_q lifts from level n to n+1 if and only if \kappa_0 \equiv 0 \pmod n, which occurs precisely when n \mid \chi(A). We denote the moduli stack of q-local systems on X by \mathrm{LocSys}_{G_q}(X).
